activities.name: Lkup Dim Managed Tables to Load
activities.description: This lookup gets the list of dimension tables that need to be processed, table is active, refresh frequency elapsed, NO stored procedure is needed to process the data, and source table name not like %fact%.

source.sqlReaderQuery:
select m.*, e.SuccessEMails, e.FailureEMails
from ingestion_metadata m
  join load_emails e
     on m.DataSource = e.DataSource
where m.Active=1
and m.DataSource = 'Curated2Managed'
and (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, isnull(m.LastLoadDateTime, '01/01/1900'), GETDATE()) / 60.0) >= m.RefreshFrequencyHours
and m.ProcessingStoredProcedure is null
and SourceTableName not like '%fact%'

activities.name: ForEach Dim managed table to load
activities.description: This loop processes each of the identified dimension tables.

dependsOn.activity: Lkup Dim Managed Tables to Load

activities.name: Copy data From Curated to Managed
activities.description: Copies the updated dimension data in curated to the managed table.

dependsOn.activity: Truncate Target Table

activities.name: Error Email from Copy
activities.description: Send failure email if the copy errors.

dependsOn.activity: Copy data From Curated to Managed

activities.name: Start Load
activities.description: Updates the Metadata ingestion table with the start of the table processing.

activities.name: Truncate Target Table
activities.description: Truncates the target table prior to the copy.

dependsOn.activity: Start Load

text.value:
IF OBJECT_ID('@{item().TargetTableSchema}.@{item().TargetTableName}','U') IS NOT NULL
    TRUNCATE TABLE @{item().TargetTableSchema}.@{item().TargetTableName}

activities.name: End Load Success
activities.description: Updates the Metadata ingestion table with the processing success.

dependsOn.activity: Copy data From Curated to Managed

activities.name: End Load Failure
activities.description: Updates the Metadata ingestion table with the copy failure.

dependsOn.activity: Copy data From Curated to Managed

activities.name: Success Email
activities.description: Send success email.

dependsOn.activity: ForEach Fact managed table to load With Prereqs
